chunks: And Muhammad ibn Ya'qub also narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zur'arah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Regarding
a man who enters with a woman, then she claims the dowry from him, he said: 'When he has entered with her, he has demolished the immediate [dowry].'
ai.seo_question: When does the full dowry become due to the wife in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that consummation ('dakhala biha') triggers the immediate entitlement to the full dowry, effectively 'demolishing' any deferred portion. This ruling underscores the principle that the wife's right to the mahr is secured upon physical union, a key concept in Shia jurisprudence regarding marital financial rights.
